result.title: 4-Tensor Attention Model for Semantic Physical Reality
result.summary: We describe a 4-tensor attention model that predicts the next semantic state of a scene, for video generation and robot planning. A window of states has positions (x, t) and two fibers, a semantic fiber and a temporal-context fiber, and one softmax normalizes attention jointly over the window. Frames and an agent's situation are written as those states; the encoder, the renderer, and the planner remain outside the update. To test the update on its own, we train on ROCStories, where each window poses the same next-sentence task at the semantic layer. On the validation split, with one seed per setting, the last-sentence cross-entropy on the three matched settings is lower for the 4-tensor model than for a free-running one-dimensional transformer by 5.3% at H=2, L=2, by 2.6% at H=4, L=2, and by 2.4% at H=4, L=3. At H=4, L=2 the parameter counts are nearly the same, 172.5M and 175.9M. On the same two GPUs that 4-tensor run finished in 2.4 hours and the baseline run in 45.2 hours; the baseline is trained by free-running decoding, one sequential forward pass per target token.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 4-tensor attention 模型：窗口内状态带 (x, t) 位置及语义纤维与时间上下文纤维，单个 softmax 联合归一化，一次性预测场景的下一语义状态；在 ROCStories 上用相同「下一句」任务与自由运行的一维 transformer 对比，末句交叉熵更低（约 2.4%–5.3%），训练时间也大幅缩短。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以张量分解注意力对状态窗口做并行更新、而非逐 token 自回归解码，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的并行生成方式及注意力结构（深度、位置、缓存）的影响提供可核查的方法线索；但论文面向视频生成与机器人规划，与 VLM 推理无直接验证联系。
